A '''sweet berry Danish''' is the meal of [[Sweet Berries|sweet berries]]. It heals {{Hp|8}} and grants {{EffectLink|Health Boost}} II, 4 extra hearts of maximum health, for 8 minutes.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/crafting/sweet_berry_danish.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
[[Sweet Berry Mash|Sweet berry mash]], sugar, [[cheese]] and dough. Obtaining sweet berry mash unlocks the recipe.

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating one takes 1.6 seconds, heals {{Hp|8}} and gives Health Boost II for 8:00.

=== Trading ===
It is one of the foods a villager can ask for as its [[favorite food]].

== History ==
{{History|
{{History line|1.12.1-alpha|The recipe and the traded Danish now give the same item.}}
